move.speech: I have thought it over and over again in my heart. It is not the way of our fathers, but the way of the rich and the men of the town who are called great men, to buy land and live as they please on it, but they all live in houses in the town, and they have money in their hands, and they have silver in their cabinets, and they have gold in their walls. These things are more than land, and I wish to have them and I wish to have them all.
